relations.note: the moonlit sit-and-wait hunter; learned to fake the light code
same dense, echoing air: Rondo talks by long hums, Ecolumbre keeps sound for seeing and talks with light
Ecolumbre's low hums travel through valley fog (F4) and soothe Rondo herds (Rondo loves song +12), allowing the player or Ecolumbre to approach safely.
Zanco relies on speed and long legs (Zancuda) to flee; Ecolumbre relies on climbing and tube-hiding (Babosa/Merodeador build). Zanco avoids tides; Ecolumbre migrates with them.
Espinodo is a carnivore that eats meat and bone (F26); Ecolumbre is a soft-bodied grazer/crustacean-eater, making it prey.
Garfio heckles and interrupts courtship with noise; Ecolumbre's low hums (F4) carry far and are harder to mask, maintaining flock sync against disruption.
Ecolumbre grazes biofilm and salt crusts (F23) on Coloso's skin, providing cleaning service; Coloso offers shelter or transport to mineral licks.
Player species can mimic Ecolumbre's ventral flashes and low hums to befriended flocks or calm Rondo herds.
Nocturnal creature has night variant bonus; Ecolumbre syncs to tides and uses flashes in twilight/dawn (F3), avoiding deep night competition.
Albinos lack pigment; Ecolumbre thrives at UV-stressed grit licks (F14) where albinos suffer higher damage, securing access to mineral licks.

journal.en: Juveniles only click; the full light language comes with the breeding season.
journal.es: Las crías solo chasquean; el lenguaje de luz llega con la época de cría.
